mapper.sql: id, user_id, item_type, selection_hash, hotel_id, room_type_id, rate_plan_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, quantity, adults, children, activity_id, package_id, slot_id, unit_quantities, special_requests, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_cart_items ( id, user_id, item_type, selection_hash, hotel_id, room_type_id, rate_plan_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, quantity, adults, children, activity_id, package_id, slot_id, unit_quantities, special_requests, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{itemType}, #{selectionHash}, #{hotelId}, #{roomTypeId}, #{ratePlanId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{quantity}, #{adults}, #{children}, #{activityId}, #{packageId}, #{slotId}, #{unitQuantities}::jsonb, #{specialRequests}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, selection_hash) DO UPDATE SET special_requests = EXCLUDED.special_requests, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketplace_cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM marketplace_cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selection_hash = #{selectionHash}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM marketplace_cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
